Definition: from G4655; to obscure or blind (literally or figuratively):--be full of darkness.
BiblicalUsage: Skotoo means to darken, to blind, and it darkens understanding and the sky alike. The Gentiles walk with their understanding darkened, alienated from the life of God through the ignorance in them, the smoke of the pit darkened the sun and the air, and the kingdom of the beast was full of darkness.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a darkened understanding is the deepest darkness of all, because the sun can rise again but a blind heart must be opened by God.
